summary: A melanocytic nevus is a very common, usually harmless mole-like growth on the skin made up of pigment-producing cells. Most people have several of these and they are typically benign.
general_characteristics: Usually round or oval with a well-defined border
Consistent brown, tan, or skin-colored shade throughout
Generally stays the same size and shape over long periods
Can appear anywhere on the body, often starting in childhood or young adulthood
when_to_see_a_doctor: The mole changes in size, shape, or color
It develops irregular or blurry borders
It becomes itchy, painful, or starts bleeding
It looks noticeably different from your other moles
You are simply unsure or concerned about a spot on your skin
disclaimer: This is an educational screening tool, not a medical diagnosis. Please consult a dermatologist or other qualified healthcare professional for an accurate evaluation of any skin concern.
